internal_clean_qualification.reason: The replay package index returned no TensorFlow 2.15.1 distribution.

online_official_path.failure: TensorFlow resolution reached tensorflow-cpu-aws but then reported no compatible NumPy distribution despite compatible ARM wheels existing.

failure_taxonomy.observation: Official could download the ARM TensorFlow metadata but pip then reported that no compatible NumPy distribution existed; the execution adapter recorded infrastructure=null.
failure_taxonomy.constraint: An exit-only observation cannot reliably distinguish a genuinely unsatisfiable requirement from a transiently incomplete package-index response.
failure_taxonomy.operation: T bypassed TensorFlow's transitive resolver with a real no-deps ARM distribution and a smaller explicit dependency set; C1 retained the complete C0 program.

matched_continuations.causal_interpretation: Target feedback changed the program and reduced observed execution time, but it did not add terminal success because the typed-null continuation also Official-passed.
